_comment: Small demo config to pair with Seed-DemoLab.ps1. No group-to-reviewer mappings, so every grant routes to that person's own AD manager - the simplest routing story to narrate on camera. Grants whose owner cannot be resolved land in the _unrouted package instead of being dropped.

groups.name: Enclave-HPC-Users
groups.plain_language: Members can log into the enclave HPC nodes and run jobs against CUI datasets.

groups.name: Enclave-Storage-RW
groups.plain_language: Members can read and modify files on the CUI project shares.

groups.name: Enclave-VPN-Access
groups.plain_language: Members can reach the enclave network remotely through the VPN.

groups.name: Enclave-Admins
groups.plain_language: Members hold administrative rights over enclave servers. Privileged group.
